description: Rajasthan Police Hackathon 2026 About the Hackathon Rajasthan Police Hackathon 2026 is an initiative of R4C (Rajasthan Cyber Crime Control Centre), Rajasthan Police, aimed at encouraging innovation and developing technology-driven solutions to address real-world challenges in cybersecurity, digital forensics, financial fraud investigation, and emerging technologies. The hackathon provides a platform for students, developers, innovators, and technology enthusiasts to collaborate and develop practical solutions to challenges faced by law enforcement agencies. Participants will work on real-world problem statements provided by Rajasthan Police and develop innovative solutions using technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Analytics, OSINT, Cybersecurity, and Digital Forensics. Teams will initially register and submit their proposed solutions through an action plan. Based on the evaluation of these submissions, the top 25 teams will be invited to participate in the 24-hour offline grand finale at Rajasthan Police Academy, Jaipur. Think. Build. Innovate. Contribute Towards a Safer Digital Rajasthan. For More Details, Visit: https://rajasthanpolicehackathon.in/

Rajasthan Police Hackathon 2026

About the Hackathon

Rajasthan Police Hackathon 2026 is an initiative of R4C (Rajasthan Cyber Crime Control Centre), Rajasthan Police, aimed at encouraging innovation and developing technology-driven solutions to address real-world challenges in cybersecurity, digital forensics, financial fraud investigation, and emerging technologies.

The hackathon provides a platform for students, developers, innovators, and technology enthusiasts to collaborate and develop practical solutions to challenges faced by law enforcement agencies.

Participants will work on real-world problem statements provided by Rajasthan Police and develop innovative solutions using technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Analytics, OSINT, Cybersecurity, and Digital Forensics.

Teams will initially register and submit their proposed solutions through an action plan. Based on the evaluation of these submissions, the top 25 teams will be invited to participate in the 24-hour offline grand finale at Rajasthan Police Academy, Jaipur.

Think. Build. Innovate. Contribute Towards a Safer Digital Rajasthan.

For More Details, Visit: https://rajasthanpolicehackathon.in/
